name: request-transit
description: Transit: a public transit map for your requests. Animates one trace (OpenTelemetry or Datadog) as a subway map.

scripts.test: node skills/request-transit/scripts/test-normalize.mjs && node skills/request-transit/scripts/test-contracts.mjs && node core/test-vocab.mjs && node scripts/build-plugin-skill.mjs --check
scripts.build: node core/build.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/otel-demo-checkout.otlp.json --out out/otel/transit.html --title "Checkout: one order through the Astronomy Shop" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-built trace in OTLP JSON shape"
scripts.build:dd: node core/build.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/datadog-sample.json --out out/dd/transit.html --title "Order create, from a Datadog-shaped trace" --subtitle "Fictional services  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-made sample in Datadog span JSON shape"
scripts.render: node core/render.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/otel-demo-checkout.otlp.json --name otel --title "Checkout: one order through the Astronomy Shop" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-built trace in OTLP JSON shape"
scripts.render:dd: node core/render.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/datadog-sample.json --name dd --title "Order create, from a Datadog-shaped trace" --subtitle "Fictional services  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-made sample in Datadog span JSON shape"
scripts.verify: node core/verify.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/otel-demo-checkout.otlp.json --name otel --title "Checkout: one order through the Astronomy Shop" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-built trace in OTLP JSON shape"
scripts.verify:dd: node core/verify.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/datadog-sample.json --name dd --title "Order create, from a Datadog-shaped trace" --subtitle "Fictional services  ·  SYNTHETIC hand-made sample in Datadog span JSON shape"
scripts.render:posthog: node core/render.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/posthog-checkout.json --name posthog --title "Checkout, from a PostHog Distributed Tracing trace" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC sample in PostHog trace-endpoint shape"
scripts.verify:posthog: node core/verify.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/posthog-checkout.json --name posthog --title "Checkout, from a PostHog Distributed Tracing trace" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC sample in PostHog trace-endpoint shape"
scripts.test:ui: npm run -s build && npm run -s index:example && npm run -s build:contracts && node skills/request-transit/scripts/test-ui.mjs out/otel/transit.html --shot out/ui/panel-open.png --contracts-page out/otel-contracts/transit.html --contracts-shot out/ui/panel-contracts.png --scroll-shots out/ui && node core/test-network.mjs
scripts.render:tempo: node core/render.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/tempo-checkout.json --name tempo --title "Checkout, from a Grafana Tempo trace" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC sample in Tempo /api/v2/traces shape"
scripts.verify:tempo: node core/verify.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/tempo-checkout.json --name tempo --title "Checkout, from a Grafana Tempo trace" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC sample in Tempo /api/v2/traces shape"
scripts.render:xray: node core/render.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/xray-checkout.json --name xray --title "Checkout, from an AWS X-Ray trace" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC sample in AWS X-Ray BatchGetTraces shape"
scripts.verify:xray: node core/verify.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/xray-checkout.json --name xray --title "Checkout, from an AWS X-Ray trace" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC sample in AWS X-Ray BatchGetTraces shape"
scripts.build:contracts: node core/build.mjs skills/request-transit/samples/otel-demo-checkout.otlp.json --contracts --out out/otel-contracts/transit.html --title "Checkout: one order through the Astronomy Shop" --subtitle "OpenTelemetry Demo service names  ·  SYNTHETIC trace + SYNTHETIC example code in skills/request-transit/examples/astronomy-shop"
